name: DoubleAttention
reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    b, c, h, w = x.shape
    if b == 0 or c == 0 or h == 0 or w == 0:
        return x
    c_m = c
    c_n = max(1, c // 8)
    convA = nn.Conv2d(c, c_m, 1).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    convB = nn.Conv2d(c, c_n, 1).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    convV = nn.Conv2d(c, c_n, 1).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    recon = nn.Conv2d(c_m, c, 1).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)

    A = convA(x).view(b, c_m, -1)
    B = F.softmax(convB(x).view(b, c_n, -1), dim=-1)
    V = F.softmax(convV(x).view(b, c_n, -1), dim=-1)
    global_descriptors = torch.bmm(A, B.permute(0, 2, 1))
    tmpZ = torch.bmm(global_descriptors, V)
    tmpZ = tmpZ.view(b, c_m, h, w)
    tmpZ = recon(tmpZ)
    return tmpZ
